supersededCandidate.label: front-5mp-badge
supersededCandidate.method: Every source-texture pixel with alpha>=128 is checked at its center against assembled physical triangles transformed into label coordinates. Barycentric orthographic ray/surface intersection; max local-Z gives nearest outward support, without a one-sided-normal assumption. No textured label, UNKNOWN text, live framebuffer or invisible input plane supplies support.

reason: A flat badge plane intersected the curved/raised source lens-carrier shoulder. Final model maps the unchanged badge RGB/alpha onto the real CAD surfaces instead. No whole-photo lift/stretch or fabricated paper support.
